# MG Salvage

> MG Salvage is a professional salvage and vehicle acquisition company headquartered in Sanford, North Carolina. We buy junk, damaged, and unwanted vehicles from consumers and businesses across central North Carolina.

## Services

- **Cash for Junk Cars** — Get a fair, no-obligation cash offer for your junk, damaged, or unwanted vehicle.
- **Free Towing** — We pick up your vehicle at no cost, with same-day and next-day options available.
- **Business Vehicle Removal** — Lot clearing, abandoned vehicle removal, and scheduled pickups for mechanic shops, auto body centers, and used car dealers.
- **Lot Clearing** — Clear multiple vehicles from commercial lots on your schedule.

## Service Areas

MG Salvage serves a 50-mile radius from Sanford, NC, including:

- **Sanford, NC** (Lee County) — Our headquarters
- **Fayetteville, NC** (Cumberland County)
- **Pittsboro, NC** (Chatham County)
- **Carthage, NC** (Moore County)
- **Lillington, NC** (Harnett County)

## How It Works

1. Request an estimate — fill out our form or call us with your vehicle details
2. Get a cash offer — usually within minutes
3. Schedule free pickup — same-day or next-day available
4. Get paid on the spot — cash in hand when we pick up the vehicle

## FAQ — Common Questions

**What types of vehicles do you buy?**
We buy all types of vehicles regardless of condition — junk cars, damaged vehicles, non-running cars, trucks, SUVs, vans, and even commercial vehicles.

**Do I need a title to sell my junk car?**
While having a clean title makes the process faster, we can still purchase vehicles with salvage titles or even no title in many cases.

**How quickly can you pick up my vehicle?**
In most cases, we can schedule same-day or next-day pickup. Our team operates Monday through Saturday.

**Is towing really free?**
Yes, towing is always free. We never charge for vehicle pickup or towing.
